bio_en: Yervand Baberian, known as Jallad, began his revolutionary work in the 1890s. In 1899 he was entrusted with getting arms to Murad and Hrayr in Sasun but was forced by the massacres to stop and work in Khnus. In 1903 he joined Khan's cavalry band crossing to aid Sasun, fought at Gomadzor, and when Khan fell escaped across the Russian border with a few comrades. Released from prison when the World War began in 1914, he joined Keri's unit as commander of its cavalry company, and he died in the Red Cross hospital in Urmia on 6 August 1916.
